items.title: Hyundai to build more cars in America, betting big on new hybrids and trucks, CEO says
items.summary: Despite strong sales and growing momentum, Hyundai CEO Carlos Munoz is going on the offensive in the US.

items.title: Ford Goes All In on Bronco With Massive Portfolio Refresh Planned
items.summary: Investors and Ford consumers should cheer that the Bronco is expected to get a truck and luxury Lincoln version.

items.title: Tesla Is Worth Twenty-Five Times More Than Ford
items.summary: Ford sells America's best-selling vehicle and dominates the truck market, yet its entire company is valued at a sliver of what investors hand Tesla. The gap between those two realities raises a question worth sitting with.

items.title: 3 Reasons F is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Since February 2026, Ford has been in a holding pattern, posting a small loss of 3.2% while floating around $13.95. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 10.8% gain during that period.

items.title: The 30-Year U.S. Treasury Bond Now Has a Higher Yield Than Ford and Coca-Cola. Is It Now the Best Asset for Passive Income?
items.summary: The yield on the 30-year U.S. Treasury bond has surged past 5.2% and, not too long ago, had surpassed 5.3%.

items.title: My Genius Uncle's Spreadsheet Predicts Exactly When You Can Retire
items.summary: There was no problem Uncle Dave couldn't solve with a spreadsheet. And retirement was just another question he could crunch.

items.title: The Real Engine That Could Power Tesla Stock Higher
items.summary: Forget the humanoid robots for a minute; the most potent catalyst for the stock may already be hitting the streets, and it's growing exponentially.

items.title: Trump Just Gave Canada Until January 1. If There’s No Deal, 50% Tariffs Hit Cars and Steel
items.summary: Trump's January 1 deadline gives GM and Ford just four months to rethink supply chains that took decades to build, and a little-known legal wrinkle could make the whole tariff structure collapse before either company finishes planning around it.
